evidence_classes.ARCHIVED: paper-reported constant; not a current runtime result
evidence_classes.EXACT_FRESH: current canonical-cohort result admitted by the table-appropriate safety gate
evidence_classes.NOT_MEASURED: required runtime evidence is absent or incomplete
evidence_classes.PROTOCOL_CONTROLLED_RECONSTRUCTION: Table 5.5 S4-versus-HCA comparison on one canonical population and fixed denominator, without exact per-segment fault-release pairing
evidence_classes.RECONSTRUCTED: derived only from named exact runs or the registered line mapping
evidence_classes.TOPOLOGY_PROVEN_RECONSTRUCTION: Table 5.5 primary success reconstructed from a saturated directed-topology upper bound

interruption_success.fresh_hca_comparison_scope: protocol-controlled reconstruction on the same canonical input and 28506 denominator; S4 uses the registered 2.5 m/s no-fault release trace while faulted HCA realizes its own partial release, so this is not an exact per-segment release-paired comparison
interruption_success.pair_5_7_override: archived workbook case-specific 33->44,46->36; fresh exact-label run yielded 8013/28506 rather than the cached 13939/28506, so the row is archived-only and not a global line-5 remap
interruption_success.topology_proven_scope: primary only; timing and deadline views are censored and NOT_MEASURED

protocol.winner_rule: computed cell by cell; missing or incomplete evidence is NOT_MEASURED
